output.summary: An herb native to South America, it has opposite, toothed leaves and small flower heads with white outer florets around yellow centres. In Colombia and Oaxaca it is used in soups; it can also go in leaf salads, while in eastern Africa its wild-collected leaves, stems and flowers are eaten or dried and powdered for soup.
output.edibilityNote: Used in Colombian and Oaxacan soups and leaf salads; in eastern Africa, leaves, stems and flowers are eaten or dried for soup.
